# UI.UIController

> Central UI manager that builds the Gaxia templates.

- Package: `UI.UIController` · Category: Client UI
- Starts at server boot: only when picked; otherwise the first time game code uses it
- Installing it also installs: [UI.Templates](UI.Templates.md)
- Check it is installed: `GaxiaServer.IsInstalled("UI.UIController")` on the server; `Gaxia.IsInstalled("UI.UIController")` on the client

## `Gaxia.UI.UIController`

- Runs: **client only (LocalScript / client ModuleScript)**
- Source: `src/ReplicatedStorage/Gaxia_Packages/Client/UI/UIController.lua`

Get it:

```lua
local Gaxia = require(game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage").Gaxia_Packages)
local UIController = Gaxia.UI.UIController
```

### Functions

- `UIController.GetActiveScreen(): ScreenGui?`
  Returns PlayerGui.Gaxia_UI, creating it (ResetOnSpawn off, with the HUD and Overlays folders) the first time any Gaxia UI module asks. A Gaxia_UI made in StarterGui is reused: it waits up to 5 s for Roblox to copy it into PlayerGui; with no copy yet (no character) it returns a stand-in whose content moves into the copy when it arrives, so call this again rather than keeping the result. Nil only when something that is not a ScreenGui is named Gaxia_UI.
- `UIController.HUD(): Folder?`
  Container for persistent on-screen elements (health bars, text labels): the Folder PlayerGui.Gaxia_UI.HUD, created on demand. Nil only when a non-Folder named HUD is already in Gaxia_UI.
- `UIController.Overlays(): Folder?`
  Container for modal / temporary UI (menus, dialogs, inventory): the Folder PlayerGui.Gaxia_UI.Overlays, created on demand. Nil only when a non-Folder named Overlays is already in Gaxia_UI.
- `UIController.CloneTemplate(templateName: TemplateName | string, parent: Instance?): GuiObject?`
  Builds a fresh instance of the named template via the code-first Templates module, parents it (default = active ScreenGui), and flips Visible=true so callers can stage further without an extra step. The legacy name "CloneTemplate" is preserved so existing call sites (NotificationService / HealthBarController / MenuController / InventoryController) keep working — semantics are identical from their perspective.
